Noor Al-Farsi is a frontend engineer whose work consistently elevates the quality and reach of our consulting projects. Her expertise in Next.js and React shapes how our teams approach scalable, performance-driven interfaces. She recently rearchitected a client’s dashboard to improve load times by 40% while maintaining accessibility standards, a decision that influenced cross-team best practices. Her TypeScript rigor ensures codebases remain maintainable, and she mentors junior engineers to adopt similar discipline.  

Beyond technical skills, Noor’s commitment to web accessibility—particularly WCAG compliance—sets her apart. She champions inclusive design, often refining components to meet AA standards without compromising user experience. Her ability to balance complexity with clarity makes her a trusted collaborator in high-stakes projects.  

In team settings, Noor thrives as a problem-solver. During a recent migration from Webpack to Vite, she led the transition with minimal downtime, leveraging her deep understanding of build tools. Her proactive communication and calm under pressure stabilize teams during tight deadlines.  

Noor’s dedication to excellence and her knack for turning technical challenges into opportunities make her a valuable asset. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any role requiring both technical depth and collaborative leadership.
